name: github-code-linkify
description: A Chrome extension that enhances GitHub browsing by providing URL highlighting and click functionality directly on code lines in pull requests, commits, and code blobs views.
author: Hunter Tiger Davis

scripts.sync: node sync-version.js && git add manifest.json package.json icons/version-badge.svg
scripts.patch: pnpm version patch --no-git-tag-version && pnpm run sync
scripts.minor: pnpm version minor --no-git-tag-version && pnpm run sync
scripts.major: pnpm version major --no-git-tag-version && pnpm run sync
